question: Which goddess who removes all obstacles always protects from obstacles?
premises: The mantra begins with oṃ and hrīṃ.
The goddess is called remover of all obstacles.
Continual protection from obstacles is requested.
inference: The obstacle-removing goddess is invoked to always protect from obstacles.
plain_english: oṃ hrīṃ — may the goddess who removes all obstacles always protect me from obstacles.
